name: mmw-memory
description: Shared project memory across ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other supported AI tools.

interface.longDescription:
Switch AI tools without copying your saved project context between chats.

MMW gives ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, and other supported AI tools a shared project memory. Save important facts and decisions through one connected tool, then retrieve them through another — without explaining those details again.

Connect your tools to the same MMW project and choose what to save. Keep important project knowledge available across sessions and review its source when you retrieve it.

MMW shares information saved to your project; it does not automatically read every conversation or transfer an entire chat.
defaultPrompt: Search my MMW project for decisions saved through my other connected AI tools.
Save this project decision in MMW so I can retrieve it from another connected AI tool.
